CURRENT SCENE:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P89] 【古代的时候】人觉得祭拜非常重要
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: [古代的时候→在古代]人觉得祭拜非常重要 (her pattern: 古代的时候 -> 在古代 (corrected 18/30 in train))
  proposed by the correction model: 古代的[-时候]人觉得祭拜非常重要
  her past correction (redundant_words): 因为[-他们]觉得祭拜有很多好处 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (redundant_words): 因为他们觉得[祭拜有很多好处，对他们的生活→对生活有很多好处]
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): 而是[-他]祭拜
  rule card location_with_zai: Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear. Not an error: Do not add 上 after every place word: 农村 is already a place, so use 在农村住, not 在农村上住.
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.

[P90] 【孟子】很小的时候
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: ⟦孟子⟧很小的时候 (first appearance of 孟子: briefly introduce who this is)
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧小的时候 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction (loose_clause_connection): ⟦孟子是孩子⟧ — her note: no logic relationship with the preceding or following sentences
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧出生以后 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  rule card first_mention_introduction: When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific. Not an error: After a character has already been introduced, this rule does not require another brief introduction.
  rule card loose_clause_connection: Make the relationship between clauses or sentences clear. Add or choose a connector, a purpose phrase, or a sequence marker that shows the real connection.

[P91] 【虽然】他没有朋友
  proposed by the AI checker: [-虽然]他没有朋友 (虽然 cannot introduce this causal statement without a matching contrast.)
  her past correction (ambiguous_pronoun): [他然后没有朋友→然后孟子失去了这个朋友] — her note: “他“ is ambiguous
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 他有的时候[-只要]跟朋友玩儿 — her note: or 他有的时候跟朋友玩儿
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 他[-有的时候]只要跟朋友玩儿 — her note: wrong conjunctions, 他只要跟朋友玩儿 ; 只要……就as long as
  rule card conditional_jiu: Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future. Not an error: When you mean “sometimes,” use 有的时候, not 只要……就. 会 is appropriate when you mean “will” in the future.
  rule card ambiguous_pronoun: Use 他/她/它/他们 only when it is clear who or what they refer to. If more than one person or thing is possible, repeat the name or use a clear noun phrase. Not an error: A pronoun is fine when its referent is close and unambiguous. Do not use 你 for a story character when it refers to the reader instead.

[P92] 因为每天只【^】祭拜
  proposed by the correction model: 因为每天只[+是]祭拜
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): 而是[-他]祭拜
  her past correction (other): 他们[一起常常→常常一起]去祭拜
  her past correction (cause_result_soyi): [-所以他们]祭拜 — her note: there is no cause-effect relationship
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card cause_result_soyi: Use 所以 only when the clause before it gives the cause/reason and the clause after it is the result. If there is no cause-result relationship, delete 所以 or use a connector such as 这样, 后来, or 结果 when appropriate. Not an error: Do not flag a causal 所以 when the preceding clause genuinely causes the following result. Use 结果 for an unexpected result, and do not use 所以 for sequence (后来), manner (这样), or purpose (为了…).

[P93] 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑【了】
  proposed by the AI checker: 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑[-了] (habitual action with 老是 does not take sentence-final 了.)
  proposed by the correction model: 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑[-了]
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 他有的时候[-只要]跟朋友玩儿 — her note: or 他有的时候跟朋友玩儿
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 他[-有的时候]只要跟朋友玩儿 — her note: wrong conjunctions, 他只要跟朋友玩儿 ; 只要……就as long as
  her past correction (near_synonym_precision): 可是他们[老是有问题→碰到麻烦]
  rule card conditional_jiu: Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future. Not an error: When you mean “sometimes,” use 有的时候, not 只要……就. 会 is appropriate when you mean “will” in the future.
  rule card near_synonym_precision: Choose the near-synonym that matches the intended event, duration, possibility, degree, or meaning; similar words are not interchangeable. For example, 高兴 is short-term and can change quickly, while 幸福 is for long-term, life-related happiness. Not an error: Do not flag a word simply because it resembles another word. It is not an error when the word’s meaning fits the intended event, duration, possibility, or degree.

[P94] 孟子妈妈【看了】他的同学们对孟子不好的影响
  proposed by the AI checker: 孟子妈妈[看了→看到了]他的同学们对孟子不好的影响 (看到了 means “noticed/saw” an abstract influence.)
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 孟子妈妈[看→看到]了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响 (her pattern: 看 -> 看到 (corrected 37/71 in train))
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 孟子妈妈[看了→看到了]他的同学们对孟子不好的影响 (her pattern: 看了 -> 看到了 (corrected 3/3 in train))
  proposed by the correction model: 孟子妈妈看[了→到]他的同学们对孟子不好的影响
  her past correction (missing_story_information): ⟦孟母看出来孟子老是难过，害得他不能好好学习。⟧孟母恐怕孟子住在墓地的旁边对孟子有影响 — her note: miss information: 孟子 imitated how to offer sacrifices
  her past correction (adjective_predicate_degree): 孟母看出来孟子老是[+很]难过 — her note: usually Adj. takes 很
  her past correction (haide_harmful_result): 害得对孟子[有→受到了]不好的影响 — her note: 害得+Sb.+V.
  rule card perception_look_see: 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing. Not an error: Do not flag 看 when the meaning is only “look,” rather than successfully seeing something. 看到 does not always need 了.
  rule card missing_story_information: Do not miss important information in a retelling: include the key scene, action, motivation, or result so the event is complete and clear. Not an error: Do not flag a sentence just because it does not include every possible detail. Flag it only when an important scene, action, motivation, or result is missing and the retelling is incomplete.

[P95] 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子【^】不好的影响
  proposed by the correction model: 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子[+有]不好的影响
  her past correction (adjective_predicate_degree): 孟母看出来孟子老是[+很]难过 — her note: usually Adj. takes 很
  her past correction (missing_story_information): ⟦孟母看出来孟子老是难过，害得他不能好好学习。⟧孟母恐怕孟子住在墓地的旁边对孟子有影响 — her note: miss information: 孟子 imitated how to offer sacrifices
  her past correction (haide_harmful_result): 害得对孟子[有→受到了]不好的影响 — her note: 害得+Sb.+V.
  rule card adjective_predicate_degree: An Adj. can be the predicate without 是. Usually an Adj. takes 很 for a plain description; 是Adj.的 is used to emphasize. Not an error: Do not flag 是Adj.的 when the writer intends emphasis. Do not require 很 when another degree pattern, such as 特别, is used.
  rule card missing_story_information: Do not miss important information in a retelling: include the key scene, action, motivation, or result so the event is complete and clear. Not an error: Do not flag a sentence just because it does not include every possible detail. Flag it only when an important scene, action, motivation, or result is missing and the retelling is incomplete.

[P96] 所以孟子和孟子【^】妈妈搬家了
  proposed by the correction model: 所以孟子和孟子[+的]妈妈搬家了
  her past correction (le_completed): 所以妈妈跟孟子一起搬家[+了] — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (near_synonym_precision): 所以妈妈[跟孟子一起→带孟子]搬家
  her past correction (cause_result_soyi): [-所以]妈妈跟孟子一起搬家
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.
  rule card near_synonym_precision: Choose the near-synonym that matches the intended event, duration, possibility, degree, or meaning; similar words are not interchangeable. For example, 高兴 is short-term and can change quickly, while 幸福 is for long-term, life-related happiness. Not an error: Do not flag a word simply because it resembles another word. It is not an error when the word’s meaning fits the intended event, duration, possibility, or degree.

places.reason: Natural time expression; no correction needed.
First mention needs an identifying noun phrase.
只 can directly modify 祭拜.
老是 describes a habitual action, not completion.
The narrative means she noticed the influence.
The noun phrase does not require 有.
孟子妈妈 is an acceptable kinship phrase.
